hypotheses.L1_local_feature_selectivity: At the primary 10% input-norm edit, known-category top modes change the selected feature at least twice as much per unit edit as low modes in at least one of the raw or whitened bases.
hypotheses.L2_local_downstream_specificity: At the primary edit, known-category top modes have at least 1.5 times the downstream effect energy of low modes in at least one basis.
hypotheses.L3_local_feature_mediation: At the primary edit, at least four of five known categories reach median feature-path mediation fidelity 0.30 under at least one basis and mediator definition.
hypotheses.L4_basis_robustness: The better known-category median mediation fidelity differs by no more than 0.10 between raw and whitened bases.
hypotheses.L5_local_prospective_gap: At the primary edit, best-mediator fidelity is at least 0.10 higher for known than prospective categories in at least one basis.
